EXT. GULL POINT - POINT ROAD - DUSK

The gale coming in. Ros walks up the point road with a
holdall, and stops where the light would fall if it were lit.

                      ROS
          It's dark. It's never dark.

INT. LIGHTHOUSE - KEEPER'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

Esme at the table with the Lights Board letter. The VHF
hisses on the dresser.

                      ESME
                (to the radio)
          Ardle boat, Gull Point. Say again.

                      ARDLE COASTGUARD (V.O.)
          Still out past the Bar. Keep her
          lit.

Esme folds the letter and climbs.

                                             CUT TO:
